thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 raised - regional failover stalled, traffic still converging. Alerts: global error-rate spike, route health flaps, elevated latency for inference endpoints. Pager routed to lucas (primary) and priya (secondary).

lucas: ack - joining. Quick summary pls - what triggered the failover?

priya: auto-DR kicked due to repeated AZ route anomalies in us-west-2; controller moved a large portion of traffic to eu-central-1. Post-shift we started seeing TLS handshake timeouts and some persistent 504s from region egress proxies.

daniel: I see 30% of requests that landed in eu-central-1 are failing with upstream timeout. Logs show repeated TCP retransmits and some path MTU reported in host kernel logs: "Frag needed but DF set".

lucas: can we stop further automatic shifts? want to freeze routing while we stabilize.

priya: running: `rwctl failover suspend --ticket incident-2478901234 --reason "stabilizing target"` - suspend accepted.

infra-bot: Cloud ticket CT-551122 created with provider: "Investigating edge egress fabric in eu-central-1, packet loss and MTU anomalies reported."

sara: customer-impact update: error-rate across EU endpoints ~9%, heavy for real-time apps. Top 3 accounts with SLA alerts notified.

daniel: quick probe from edge to model pool:
```
traceroute -n eu1-edge.redwood.ai
1  10.1.0.1  0.5 ms
2  100.64.2.5  1.1 ms
3  52.16.21.7  15.2 ms
4  52.16.14.90  112 ms  * *
5  52.16.14.91  200 ms  !PMTU
```

priya: provider notes: "We are seeing intermittent MTU blackholes affecting some racks in eu-central-1b. Recommended mitigation: route egress to other AZs or enable TCP MSS clamping at our gateway."

lucas: plan: 1) weighted traffic redistribute across eu-central-1 AZs and backpressure to us-west-2; 2) enable MSS clamping on our NATs; 3) temporarily increase model pool capacity in eu to soak traffic. Execute step 1 now - small increments.

priya: executing weighted change: `route53 update-weights --name api.redwood.ai --weights us-west-2=40,eu-central-1a=20,eu-central-1c=20,eu-central-1b=20` (ramp every 90s).

support: Notification sent to customers in affected zones with ETA estimate 45-90m.

daniel: applied MSS clamping (MSS=1400) on regional NATs and lowered MTU on internal tunnel to 1400. Also bumping ASG min size +25% to handle surge.

infra-bot: CT-551122 updated: provider applying reroute for impacted racks; ETA ~30m.

lucas: running a small synthetic test load to validate handshakes:
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\\n" -o /dev/null https://eu1-edge.redwood.ai/generate; done
200 0.27
200 0.32
502 1.98
504 3.05
200 0.25
```

priya: observe: 5xxs dropped from 12% to 3% after MSS + reweights; latency p95 improved from 2.8s -> 0.9s in the last 6m.

daniel: host metrics show conntrack backlog went from 90% -> 35% after NAT change. No more PF logs complaining about fragmentation.

support: enterprise ops asked for a post-incident note for their compliance teams. Will prepare draft.

incident-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff window approaching for lucas at +120m.

lucas: I'll keep monitoring for the next 2h; priya please own follow-up action items with infra. Handing off to priya for overnight once stable.

priya: ack. Action items captured: 1) Add pre-failover PMTU probe to the runbook (owner: daniel); 2) Make auto-failover respect target region egress capacity threshold (owner: priya); 3) Improve weighted ramp cadence and add health-check for TLS handshake success (owner: lucas); 4) Run a DR traffic-shift drill next quarter covering partial AZ outages (owner: sara).

daniel: adding a temporary synthetic PMTU probe to our health-checker now. Probe uses TCP handshake with varying MSS.

infra-bot: Provider CT-551122: reroute complete for affected racks. Requesting validation.

lucas: validating - running end-to-end blackbox tests, TLS handshakes steady. No 5xxs in 15m window.

support: updating customers: issue mitigated, full status and postmortem to follow.

priya: marking incident as mitigated for impact; keeping P1 open for confirmation period of 90 minutes.

lucas: final: good job all. We'll keep channel open for the observation window; please update owners in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
